Title: Set up observability dashboards and alerts
Description: As a DevOps engineer, I want observability dashboards and alerts in Application Insights so that we can troubleshoot prod quickly during and after the demo. The dashboards visualize pipeline health, latency, errors, autoscaling events, and cost, alerts are configured for P0/P1 conditions (high error rate, service down, high cost spike), and logs and traces are ingested and queryable.
AcceptanceCriteria: Application Insights dashboard created with service health tiles
Dashboard shows pipeline stage latency percentiles (p50, p95, p99)
Dashboard displays autoscaling events and Container App instance count
Dashboard shows error rates by service and stage
Alerts configured for: service unhealthy, error rate >5%, cost spike >threshold
All 11 services emit logs and traces to Application Insights
Queries for common troubleshooting scenarios are saved (e.g., document flow, failures)
TalkingPoints: I'm going to build observability dashboards to monitor pipeline health in prod. The dashboard will show latency, errors, scaling, and cost, and alerts will fire for P0/P1 issues. This is going to enable rapid troubleshooting during the demo and after launch.
